paragraphs.text: If you leave something on one of our buses, contact our lost property office within 30 days. After that time, unclaimed items are given to charity, except for documents such as passports, which are sent to the relevant authority.
You can report a lost item online or by visiting the office at the central bus station. We do not accept reports by phone, as we need a written description of the item.

When an item matching your description is found, we will send you a message. You will need to collect it in person and show photo identification. A handling fee of £3 is charged for each item, but there is no fee for lost travel passes.
We cannot accept responsibility for items left on buses, and we do not pay compensation for lost property.

To make lost items easier to return, we recommend writing your name and phone number inside bags and on umbrellas. Items handed in by drivers are recorded on our system by the end of the next working day.

items.quote: except for documents such as passports, which are sent to the relevant authority
items.prompt: Unclaimed passports are given to charity after 30 days.

explanation.en: Items go to charity, “except for documents such as passports”, which go to the authority → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Заттар қайырымдылыққа беріледі, «except for documents such as passports» — төлқұжаттар тиісті мекемеге жіберіледі → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Вещи уходят в благотворительность, «except for documents such as passports» — паспорта отправляют в госорган → FALSE.

items.quote: We do not accept reports by phone
items.prompt: Lost items can be reported by telephone.

explanation.en: “We do not accept reports by phone” — reports by telephone are not possible → FALSE.
explanation.kk: «We do not accept reports by phone» — телефонмен хабарлауға болмайды → FALSE.
explanation.ru: «We do not accept reports by phone» — по телефону сообщить нельзя → FALSE.

items.quote: When an item matching your description is found, we will send you a message
items.prompt: Customers are contacted when a matching item is found.

explanation.en: “When an item matching your description is found, we will send you a message”. Being sent a message is being contacted → TRUE.
explanation.kk: «When an item matching your description is found, we will send you a message» — зат табылғанда хабарлама жібереді. «Customers are contacted» = «we will send you a message» → TRUE.
explanation.ru: «When an item matching your description is found, we will send you a message» — когда вещь найдут, пришлют сообщение. «Customers are contacted» = «we will send you a message» → TRUE.

items.quote: contact our lost property office within 30 days
items.prompt: Most lost items are found within a week.

explanation.en: The text gives a deadline for contacting the office (“within 30 days”) but nothing about how quickly items are found. The 30 is a distractor → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Мәтінде хабарласу мерзімі бар («within 30 days»), бірақ заттар қаншалықты тез табылатыны туралы дерек жоқ. 30 саны — жаңылыстыратын сан → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: В тексте есть срок для обращения («within 30 days»), но нет данных о том, как быстро находят вещи. Цифра 30 — дистрактор → NOT GIVEN.

items.quote: there is no fee for lost travel passes
items.prompt: There is no charge for collecting a lost travel pass.

explanation.en: There is a £3 fee per item, “but there is no fee for lost travel passes” — “no charge” = “no fee” → TRUE.
explanation.kk: Әр затқа £3 алым бар, «but there is no fee for lost travel passes»: «no charge» = «no fee» → TRUE.
explanation.ru: Сбор £3 за вещь, «but there is no fee for lost travel passes» — «no charge» = «no fee» → TRUE.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Look at the text. Do the following statements agree with the information given in the text? Write TRUE if the statement agrees with the information, FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, or NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.
